{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column from string to float, handling any non-numeric values
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Confirm the number of completed orders
num_completed_orders = len(completed_orders)

mean_revenue_completed, num_completed_orders"}
